newsitem.title: BURMA: Burma creates new sports ministry.
newsitem.headline: Burma creates new sports ministry.

text.p: Burma's military government said on Thursday that it created a new ministry for sports and appointed Colonel Sein Win as the minister.
The new appointment brings the total number of ministers in the ruling State Law and Order Restoration Council's (SLORC) cabinet to 39.
"In order to bring about further effectiveness and success in endeavouring the promotion of sports standards in the nation, the SLORC has formed the ministry of sports," the media said.
No background or details about Sein Win were provided in the media.
